use default

to_octets(value: long) -> LIST[ubyte] is
    let octets = LIST([cast ubyte(value & 0x7FL)])
    let rest mut = value >> 7

    while rest > 0L do
        octets.insert(0, cast((rest & 0x7FL) | 0x80L))
        rest = rest >> 7
    od

    octets
si

from_octets(octets: List[ubyte]) -> long =>
    octets
        |> reduce(0L, (value: long, octet: ubyte) =>
            (value << 7) | cast(cast(octet) & 0x7F))

as_hex(octet: ubyte) -> string => "{octet:X2}"

[0x200000L, 0x1FFFFFL]
    |> each((value: long) =>
        (let octets = to_octets(value)
         let shown = octets |> map(as_hex) |> join(" ")

         write_line("{value,8} = 0x{value:X6} -> {shown}"
